summary: Three full-length passages (870, 857, 851 words) with rising difficulty and a proper IELTS question mix; all keys are correct. Y/N/NG items were out of passage order and are fixed. Some sentence endings in passage 3 copy the passage word for word and are easy.
strengths: Passage lengths and register match the real test; passage 3 (background music) has C1 argument and hedging.
NOT GIVEN items (Q10, Q13, Q38) are truly unaddressed; FALSE/NO items are clearly contradicted.
Matching people in passage 2 has a fifth person (Kenji Mori) who is quoted but never the answer, a real distractor.

issues.problem: Y/N/NG order was broken: Q37 (banning music, last paragraph) came before Q38 (paragraph 4), and Q40 (silence, paragraph 3) came last.
issues.change: Swapped the prompts of Q37 and Q40 in mock3-reading.js and their explanations/evidence in mock-vocab-A.json. Both keys are NO, so the answer key and past attempts are unchanged; Q36-40 now follow paragraphs 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

issues.problem: Sentence endings copy the passage: A "tend to be more affected by background music than outgoing people" and F "suffers particularly when the music includes lyrics" are exact quotes, and Q32 repeats the point already tested in Q29.
issues.change: Paraphrase the endings, e.g. A "are more easily disturbed by music playing in the background than extroverts", F "is harmed most by songs with words"; and make Q32 test another detail.

issues.problem: Passage 2 tests some points twice (Halvorsen: Q21 and Q24; Adeyemi: Q22 and Q25; Reyes: Q16 and Q26).
issues.change: Replace one of each pair, e.g. a matching item on Mori's disease warning so the distractor person is also a real option for one statement.

issues.problem: The old paraphrase pair quoted "unpaid volunteers", which is not in the passage.
issues.change: Pair replaced with ["volunteers, unpaid", "people who were not paid for the work"].
